stories.title: New plan sets out scale of football facility shortfall in Flintshire with ten sites identified for investment
stories.summary: Flintshire has half the number of full-size 3G football pitches it needs for its current player base, according to a new plan that identifies three priority sites for new pitches at Deeside Leisure Centre, Hawarden High School and St David’s High School in Saltney. stories.title: Motorcyclist stopped at 96mph on return trip to Wirral from north Wales found with illegal tyre
stories.summary: A motorcyclist travelling at 96mph on a return journey to the Wirral from north Wales has been stopped by North Wales Police roads officers and found to be riding on an illegal rear tyre, with a pillion passenger on board. stories.title: Welsh Ambulance Service stands down critical incident declared during extreme heat
stories.summary: The Welsh Ambulance Service has stood down a critical incident declared three days ago during the recent period of extreme heat, but has warned that demand on 999 remains high. stories.title: Borderlands line passengers could be overpaying at station terminals, Flintshire councillor warns
stories.summary: A motion going before Flintshire County Council this week calls for a public warning over contactless payment terminals at Borderlands line train stations, after warning that some passengers are being charged more than they need to pay. stories.title: Survey shows 75% of Wrexham University graduates enter high-skilled employment
stories.summary: Three in four Wrexham University graduates are now in high-skilled employment, according to the latest UK Graduate Outcomes Survey. The study, run by HESA (Higher Education Statistics Agency), gathered results from 353,755 people across the UK 15 months following their graduation.
